description: This file implements the AppGateway plugin class for the WPEFramework, providing JSON-RPC methods for ping, getInfo, and setConfig, along with event notification for state changes.

classes.name: AppGateway
classes.description: A plugin class for the WPEFramework that provides JSON-RPC endpoints and event notifications for application gateway management.

methods.name: AppGateway
methods.description: Constructor initializing the plugin and registering RPC methods.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the provided service shell, reading configuration and setting initial state.

methods.name: Information
methods.description: Returns version information about the plugin.

methods.name: endpoint_ping
methods.description: Responds with 'pong' to a ping request.

methods.name: endpoint_getInfo
methods.description: Provides plugin information including name, version, and current state.

methods.name: endpoint_setConfig
methods.description: Sets configuration parameters such as enabled state and route table.

methods.name: event_statechanged
methods.description: Emits a notification when the state changes.
